title: NLS+13 10-round AES-128 Clockwise-collision EM subkey recovery / shift

target.description: Full AES128 hardware implementation; Algorithm1 outputs ONE8-bit last-round subkey Kr. The experiment is not a complete128-bit master-key recovery.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key; no related-key oracle.
setting.key_population: General unknown key; target shift byte has collision probability1/256.
setting.plaintext_model: Unknown/random plaintexts and public ciphertexts; no chosen-plaintext or chosen-key profiling device required.
assumptions: Parallel128-bit loop architecture with16 composite-field S-boxes and no SCA countermeasures.
Local EM probe observes one target8-bit S-box/register at the last round; shift register mapping.
SASEBO-G, XilinxVirtex-IIProXC2VP7-5FG456C FPGA at8MHz; AgilentDSO7032A, WM7000-HC020 EM probe, YCK1000AMP amplifier.
Threshold h=12.5, collision count t=8; published fitted leakage distributions/Table2 and MonteCarlo Ps for t>=2.

time.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

data.note: Source M(8,12.5)=4431; footnote marker is not another count digit. Native trace count, not encryption queries. Eq6 gives M(t,h)=t/(P0*integral[-infinity,h] f0(x)dx); the quoted endpoint is retained rather than replacing it with a recomputation from rounded calibration statistics.

memory.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

preprocessing.note: The study uses100000 traces to estimate leakage statistics. This is experimental calibration, not an explicitly priced required attacker setup phase; no zero or100000-trace attack preprocessing is inferred.

success.description: Published success for this threshold/collision count and fitted experimental leakage distribution; identifies the one target subkey byte. For t>=2 the paper uses MonteCarlo under fitted leakage distributions; this is not an empirical repeated full-master-key recovery rate.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.4–5 Section3/Algorithm1 and key conditions; p.8 experiment/Table1; p.9 Fig6 paragraph/footnote1.
evidence.interpretation: Primary result, model and accounting passages checked; selected-endpoint extraction, not a completed full-paper/forward-literature audit.

evidence.locator: PDF1–15 complete; PDF6–7 Eqs1–6/MonteCarlo convention; PDF8–10 Table1/Table2/Figs4–9 and endpoint footnotes.
evidence.interpretation: Complete primary inventory. Rounded Gaussian fits are not exact remeasurement, and100000 calibration traces are not silently charged as required attack setup.

limitations: Recovers one8-bit last-round subkey on the specified unprotected local-EM hardware implementation.
The t,h measurement formula does not supply an analytic t>=2 success curve; only the published endpoint is numerically instantiated.
